privacy.label: Legal
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro[0]: Wanda Group (“we”, “us”) operates this website to present gas cylinders, accessories and related export supply, and to receive commercial inquiries from industrial buyers.
privacy.intro[1]: This policy explains what personal data we collect through the site, why we use it, and how you can contact us about it. We do not publish factory videos or certificate files on the website; those materials are sent privately on request.
privacy.sections[0].title: Who is responsible
privacy.sections[0].body[0]: The controller of personal data collected via this website is Wanda Group. For privacy requests write to sales@wandagroups.com.
privacy.sections[1].title: What data we collect
privacy.sections[1].body[0]: When you send the inquiry form we receive the data you enter: name, email, phone, destination country, product type, quantity and message.
privacy.sections[1].body[1]: The site also stores your language choice in the browser (localStorage). We do not run advertising cookies or sell visitor lists.
privacy.sections[2].title: Why we use the data
privacy.sections[2].body[0]: We use inquiry data only to reply to your request, prepare a quotation, send product information, videos or certificates that you asked for, and to coordinate an order if we start working together.
privacy.sections[2].body[1]: Legal basis: your consent when you tick the checkbox on the form, and our legitimate interest in answering B2B sales requests.
privacy.sections[3].title: Who receives the data
privacy.sections[3].body[0]: Your message is delivered to our sales team by email. Depending on configuration, the form may be processed by FormSubmit or Formspree as a technical provider that transmits the message to us.
privacy.sections[3].body[1]: We do not sell personal data. We may share what is needed with logistics, inspection or banking partners only if that is required to fulfil an agreed order.
privacy.sections[4].title: How long we keep it
privacy.sections[4].body[0]: Inquiry data is kept for as long as needed to handle the request and for a reasonable period afterwards for sales follow-up and accounting, unless you ask us to delete it earlier where the law allows.
privacy.sections[5].title: Your rights
privacy.sections[5].body[0]: You may ask for a copy of the data we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. You may withdraw consent for further marketing-style follow-up by writing to us. To exercise these rights, email sales@wandagroups.com.
privacy.sections[6].title: Security and children
privacy.sections[6].body[0]: We take reasonable technical and organisational steps to protect messages in transit and in our mailbox. This website is intended for business buyers, not for children.
